blurb: Guests can participate in riding lessons, summer camps for ages 5-18 teaching horse care and riding, and a Rider Development Clinic focused on improving riding skills and horsemanship. The summer camp includes daily riding and horse care activities culminating in a horse show. Boarding services provide full care for privately owned horses including feeding, stall cleaning, turnout, and 24-hour security.
